/: Estate overview — capacity sounding, pool tiles, protection gaps, and quick jumps into volumes, snapshots, and backups.
/volumes: Intent-backed volume inventory — create, expand, snapshot, schedule, and delete across backends.
/rbd: Raw Ceph RBD images for machina/libvirt and bare VMs (bypassing CSI).
/snapshots: Point-in-time volume snapshots — clone or restore into new volumes.
/schedules: Automate periodic snapshots or backups for a volume.
/backups: Volume backups into object buckets — create, restore, and retire copies.
/buckets: Object gateway buckets for exports and backup destinations.
/protection: Per-volume protection verdict — healthy / degraded / unprotected rollup.
/observatory: Estate telemetry canvas — capacity lenses and jump to Deck or Alerts.
/activity: Recent operator and system activity stream.
/alerts: Open alert ledger — silence or resolve before capacity work.
/metrics-dashboard: Ceph-native metric samples and OSD utilization averages.
/jobs: Durable async jobs for every mutation — progress, SSE live updates, failure detail.
/audit: Compliance trail of state-changing and sensitive actions.
/tenants: Tenant index — quotas and policy overrides.
/access: Local users for Storage Center sign-in — create and delete accounts.
/policies: Built-in intent → placement catalog (atlas-policy) used when creating volumes.
/settings: Console settings — theme and session preferences for Storage Center.
/api-docs: Curated REST + gRPC map for operators and integrators.
/databridge/sources: Register external / cloud database sources for DataBridge migrations.
/databridge/plans: Create and list DataBridge migration plans from registered sources.
/databridge/plans/:id: Single migration plan — stages, CDC controls, cutover, and validation hooks.
/databridge/edge-clusters: Edge database clusters provisioned as migration targets.
/databridge/replication: CDC replication streams for active migration plans.
/databridge/validation: Validation runs and per-table results for migrated data.
/backends: Registered storage backends — discovery and capacity summary.
/kubernetes: Discovered StorageClasses from the attached cluster.
/cluster: Primary cluster inventory — health, pools, OSDs.
/ceph: Day-2 Ceph signals — health rollup, df pools, OSD tree.
/pools/:id: Single pool sounding — volumes and OSD cells for one pool.
/maintenance: Pause the job engine, cordon backends, and clean orphan backups.
/dr: Cross-cluster RBD mirroring — peers, mirrors, promote/demote/failover.
